commentary_segments.text: Even more gain can be obtained by current cancellation For this purpose, we need to take differential diodeconnected MOSTs. Two of them provide a differential small-signal resistance of 2/g . m Cross coupling them creates a positive feedback amplifier with two stages. As a result the differential resistance becomes negative or −2/g . m This negative resistance is easily controlled through the current. It is often used in oscillators, RF voltage-controlled oscillators and in wideband amplifiers.
